faces.transcription:
MISSION BRIEFING
“We found one of Sabik's safehouses. Given his recent actions, containing him has become a higher priority. Don't send a team; you must handle it personally.
In addition, the Soviets are building another control center, and there is a third MEDUSA trial. The new strain is considerably stronger, but our research division is already developing a stopgap treatment to counteract the most severe symptoms.”
OPEN
0006
and read its contents.
